system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

response: {"headline": "The pelacarsen Phase 3 Lp(a)HORIZON trial did not meet its primary endpoint of reducing major cardiovascular events, consistent with a projected 11.3% relative risk reduction that yielded only 47.2% statistical power.", "summary": "The trial randomized 8,323 patients with established cardiovascular disease and Lp(a) ≥70 mg/dL to pelacarsen or placebo, targeting 993 primary endpoint events. The calculator projected an 11.3% relative risk reduction (HR 0.887) based on a 58.9% Lp(a) reduction from a 40 mg dose and a 19% LDL-C reduction from an 80 mg dose, far below the 16.3% reduction (HR 0.837) needed for 80% power. Median follow-up was 2.5 years versus a planned 4 years, further reducing power. The top-line readout states the primary endpoint was not met. Human genetics strongly support LPA as a causal target (Open Targets score 0.922, multiple variants with ORs 1.51–2.57 for coronary disease), so failure likely reflects an effect size too small to detect with the chosen sample and duration.
